Trine 3: The Artifacts of Power 是一款3D平臺遊戲,包含動作,拼圖和冒險.

英雄們試圖把超凡的天賦 交還給叫做Trine的藝術家 所以他們用超乎他們意識的力量 Trine 碎裂 一個無心的古老巫師逃走了
只有破碎的藝術品才能引導他們 英雄們必須試圖修復他們造成的損失 或者可能發生的損失

經驗一個童話世界 令人振奮的景色 面對著數不清的 物理上的拼圖

- 探索7個故事引發的章節和11個解謎、注重技能的失蹤頁面

- 三個好玩的角色,騎士龐提斯 小偷佐雅 巫師阿瑪迪斯 每個人都有自己的技能和獨特的能力

- 最多三名玩家的線上和本地合作多人

（以上介紹為機器翻譯）

この魅惑的なビジュアル・ノベルで、忘れられないラブストーリーを発見しよう。一瞬の視線、高鳴る鼓動...そしてすべてを変える愛。主人公は不思議な少女と偶然出会い、その瞬間から彼女を見つけなければならないと確信する。

彼女がソウルメイトだという確信に突き動かされ、彼は興奮と予期せぬ出会い、そして重大な決断に満ちた冒険に乗り出す。彼女を見つけ、彼女のハートを射止めることができるのか、それとも、彼の愛は実現不可能な夢のように消えてしまうのか。

運命とロマンスの感動的な物語に浸ってください。感情、ジレンマ、胸が高鳴る瞬間に満ちた体験。愛のサインを追う準備はできていますか？

Become one man construction crew and build houses like a simple African mud hut and as complex as a super modern energy saving architectural marvel.

BUILD AROUND THE WORLD

Let us take you on a trip to various spots on the globe and experience true architectural variety. You will try to build a mud hut in Africa, an igloo in the Arctic, a Canadian house, a log cabin in Siberia, traditional house made of bricks, airbricks or concrete and many, many more…
Every house consists of hundreds elements you need to match according to rules of construction.

LEARN NEW TECHNOLOGIES

See how the construction technologies differ from each other. Learn how to apply proper materials and procedures during building process.
Build houses brick by brick, element after element, down from the foundations and up to the roof.
Learn different structures of buildings, construction materials, their features and properties. Build simple constructions made of primitive materials, but also ultramodern buildings featuring the latest technological discoveries.

USE UNIQUE MECHANICS

Use various tools depending on the situations and requirements. Improve your skills, use better equipment to be able to build complex structures quickly and efficiently.

DEMOLISH

Sometimes there is no way out. Demolish everyting on you way and start over!

column4: 冒險、策略、格鬥、桌上遊戲
column8:
Pirates Outlaws is a roguelike deckbuilder with papercraft artstyle packed with content. Navigate dangerous seas, defeat every outlaw in your way and challenge their masters in tense combats. Your expedition will be full of ambushes and challenges, so get ready, build your card deck and plan deadly combos to become the most reputed pirate!

Features:

3 Game Modes with unique rules
16 Heroes with unlockable skins
More than 700 Cards and 200 Relics
150+ Outlaws and 60+ unique bosses
Tons of unlockables
All the 7 chapters included

DISCOVER 3 GAME MODES WITH UNIQUE RULES

Start a roguelike expedition in NAVIGATE mode! Choose between different routes across varied horizons, battling every pirate and outlaw that stands in your path. Add new cards to your deck or upgrade them and get relics to survive the trip! As you play you’ll earn Repute to unlock new maps, cards and more! When you reach 9.999 Repute you will unlock the Hard Mode with tougher enemies and unique challenges.

Face the most powerful foes in the ARENA mode. Build a deck with cards and relics from every single chapter to craft the perfect pirate warrior and battle powerful Champions every 10 Battles. The dust of the arena awaits for the best challengers!

Test your strength and knowledge over a drink in the TAVERN BRAWL mode. Choose pre-made packages before each battle and defeat waves of pirates to battle the imposing Tavern Keeper.

DOMINATE 16 DIFFERENT HEROES AND UNLOCK NEW SKINS

Play as 16 different pirates, each with unique abilities and mechanics. Read the future with the Fortune Teller, command a beast with the Bear Tamer or go full berserker with the Chicken. As you play, you’ll unlock new skins with each character. Start your next run as a steampunk legend or find the spookiest look!

BUILD YOUR DE…

Rocket Wars is a fast-paced couch party game for up to 4 players.
6 different game modes will keeps the game fresh and challenging.
12 different spaceships with unique stats lets you play according to your own playstyle.
You can play FFA, 2v2 or entirely against AI opponents.

Enjoy both pvp and coop with your friends!

Will a mother fox, the last of its kind, be able to save its three little cubs?

Experience what life would be like in a world ravaged by mankind through the eyes of the last fox on Earth in this eco-conscious adventure. 

Discover the destructive force of the human race, as it, day after day, corrupts, pollutes, and exploits the most precious and valuable resources of the natural environment. 

Explore Endling's 3D side-scrolling world and defend your cubs, three tiny and defenseless fur balls, feed them, watch them grow level after level, notice their unique personalities and fears, and most importantly, help them survive.

Use the cover of night to stealthily guide your litter towards a safer place. Spend the day resting in an improvised shelter and plan your next movement carefully since it could be the last for you and your pups.

Features:
• Explore devastated environments based on real current issues.
• Hunt other animals to feed your cubs and avoid becoming the prey.
• Put your survival instinct to the test and get involved in emotionally taxing decisions.
• Bring your pups to the last safe place where humans cannot harm them.
• Care for your kits, feed them, and teach them new skills to make them less vulnerable. 
• Survive.

Jump into the fantastic world of insects! Avoid obstacles, complete quests and develop your character. Be skillful and let yourself be carried away by the adventure in the grass
Discover the story of two children who have been magically reduced to the size of the ants. Explore magnificent worlds of the garden with them, each of these worlds full of various creatures living in the midst of grass. Collect the items you need to pass and uncover the secrets of the small-big world that you've come across.

On your way, you will meet both hostile insects and friendly characters, often in need of your help. Complete tasks and gain experience that will allow you to develop your character and win stronger and stronger opponents.

Show your agility and accuracy in various mini-games and help the brave siblings get back to their normal size!

深入可怕的 SCP Foundation: Universe Horror 世界，面對威脅現實本質的異常生物與超自然現象。作為這個神秘基金會的成員，你的任務是收容、研究並在與未知相遇時存活下來。探索昏暗詭異的設施，裡面潛藏著兇殘的SCP實體，並揭開那些被鎖住的門後的恐怖謎團。每一步都可能是你最後的一步——因為在這個宇宙中，恐怖潛伏在每一個陰影中。

主要特色：
 • 真實SCP宇宙：遇見經典SCP與靈感來自SCP神話的全新恐怖異常。
 • 沉浸式恐怖氛圍：穿梭於昏暗走廊、不安的聲響與突如其來的驚嚇中。
 • 生存機制：管理資源、避免被發現並做出關鍵決策以提高生存機率。
 • 動態AI行為：面對擁有獨特攻擊模式與策略的不可預測SCP實體。

走進去吧，但要小心——被收容的東西，不一定願意永遠被關住。

column2: Pajama Sam: Thunder And Lightning Aren't So Frightening
column8: 因為對雷暴的恐懼, Sam在沙發下已蜷縮了太多個晚上。於是他決定走上雲層之上克服它。正當他在天空中的風暴工廠開始了解到暴風雨並不像看起來那麼糟糕時，他不小心擾亂了天氣系統。\n現在他需要你的幫助來探索這奇妙的空中世界和修理損壞的機器，讓世界的天氣得以恢復正常！

您好，夥伴！歡迎來到狂野西部，火槍城已經陷入無法無天的狀態。 好戰而不要命的野雞把正直的警長趕出城，現在，在這個曾經和平的城市裡，沒有什麽東西和人是安全的。而您是鎮上的新警長，必須將這些叛亂的野雞繩之以法來恢復法律和秩序。

三關中每一關的目標都是在90秒內盡可能獵捕越多的野雞並取得越高的分數。但要小心 – 這些亡命之徒會還擊！如果您被擊中三次，遊戲就會結束。如果您射中了錯誤的野雞或錯誤的物品，分數將被扣除。您不僅要準確，還必須要完成某些任務才能進入下一關。哪些任務？您必須自己找答案！

第1關：草原
第1關發生在草原上。這裡有苦刑柱、箱子、瓶子、監獄和銀行。如果您擊落了監獄的鎖，一隻強盜雞就會跑出來並試圖搶劫銀行。要進入下一關，您必須達到至少1,100分，射擊苦刑柱並......

第2關：峽谷
在第2關，您站在火槍城前，就是您現在看到的背景。您還會看到帳篷旁邊，有一個漁夫坐在他的漁船中；一個農夫站在一箱土豆旁；還有一個主張自己是淘金者的人。要進入下一關，你必須達到至少1,000分，稍微修整一下峽谷並......

第3關：火槍城
城中有很多建築物，一個絞架和許多野雞。摧毀建築物的窗戶會讓敵人出現。本關中有很多驚喜，所以您最好是努力前行，以便找到所有的隱藏分數。

其他功能
• 排行榜——不斷打破您的最高成績，並與朋友及全球其他玩家爭奪第一名的位置。

• 遊戲指南和常見問題——閱讀遊戲提示與技巧，迅速成為一名備受尊敬的警長。

• 連線/離線——隨時隨地進行遊戲。不需要網路連線就能開始狩獵。但是，您需要網路連線才能將您的最高分數上傳到全球排行榜，並查看其他玩家的分數。

• 社群——擁有超過1500萬的遊戲銷售量，Moorhuhn是最知名且最成功的遊戲角色。 野雞與Moorhuhn Wanted一起，再次進入了狂野西部，這是一款專門為Nintendo Switch開發的遊戲。 立即加入Moorhuhn龐大的社群吧！

您還在等什麽？開始遊戲，然後在狂野西部獵捕瘋狂野雞吧！

Moorhuhn 會講中文、德語、英語、法語、意大利語、韓語、日語、荷蘭語、葡萄牙語、俄語和西班牙語。

column2: G-MODEアーカイブス+ 探偵・癸生川凌介事件譚 Vol.15「逢魔が刻の狂詩曲」
column8:
『逢魔が刻の狂詩曲（おうまがときのらぷそでぃー）』は、緻密なプロットと個性的なキャラクター達が人気の推理アドベンチャー「探偵・癸生川凌介事件譚」シリーズ第15弾。
当時個別で配信していた全4話をまとめてお届けします。癸生川探偵事務所へ舞い込んだ一件の依頼。
事務所のオーナーと旧知の仲である大道寺弦蔵（だいどうじげんぞう）からのその依頼は、盗難の犯行予告が届いた大道寺家の秘宝『常世の渡し』を守って欲しいというものだった。
癸生川不在の為、現地へ赴いた生王正生 (いくるみ まさお)と白鷺州伊綱 (さぎしま いづな) 。
そこで秘宝を巡る奇妙な事件に巻き込まれていく。

一面雪景色の大道寺家で秘宝の正体を調査していた二人。そして敷地内の雪道で、たたまれた服の側に全裸の奇妙な死体が見つかる。誰も知らないその死体が奏でる物語のピリオドとは…。

■ G-MODEアーカイブスとは
「G-MODEアーカイブス」とは、かつてのフィーチャーフォンアプリゲームを当時のまま忠実に再現しお届けする復刻プロジェクトです。

また「G-MODEアーカイブス+」は、ジー・モード以外のメーカー・パブリッシャーが開発・配信していたフィーチャーフォンアプリゲームをお届けするブランドです。

・当時のアプリをそのままお楽しみいただけるよう、WEB接続メニューや各種ボタン、キー内容などを移植再現しておりますが、一部機能しないものがあります。

A bamboozlingly funtertaining puzzle game, lovingly crafted for artists of all ages. It's all about exploding globs of icky, gooey paint in the right places at the right times! Mix together the primary colors (red, yellow, and blue) in any order to make a Brownsplosion that obliterates everything in its path. Spread the colors across conveyor belts, through portals, over filters, and into buckets on your quest to destroy the mythical Rainbow Orb.

Features:
120 spluzzles ranging from easy-peasy to brainy-squeezy
A full-featured puzzle maker for endless creativity
12 unique puzzle elements to play with
30 minutes of chill tunes to solve by, from music wizard Johan Hargne
A fun way to learn the relationships of the color wheel

It's 1788 and Mozart is in Prague. He is giving the inaugural showing of his famous opera, Don Giovanni. The plaudits he receives are universal, but very quickly the events that are shaking the capital of Bohemia will take his mind off the music.

Far from the footlights, a terrible conspiracy is underway, designed to de- throne Joseph II, Austro-Hungarian Emperor and Mozart's benefactor. Left bereft and manipulated, the musical prodigy finds himself plunged into the heart of a grand conspiracy!

With murders, sinister intrigue and occult ceremonies going on all around, only his genius will allow him to get to the bottom of this hideous plot!

Join Mozart as he must find his way through 18th century Prague, find the clues and solve the great mystery. Displayed in stunning 3D third person, Mozart will need to use all his genius to uncover the various plots, dis- cover how and who has committed various crimes and clear his name before he is charged with Murder!

Key Features
• Full 3D third person gameplay with portions in first person.
• Features the historical city of Prague modeled accurately on period maps.
• Actual characters, personalities and intrigue from historical records.
• Dozens of puzzles to solve.
• Complete dialog development and intelligent conversation while interacting with the characters.
• Player must finish writing some of Mozart’s masterpieces to eventually solve who is behind the murders.
• Conduct the Prague Symphony as part of the gameplay with a 3D controller.
• Features licensed and original scored music of the master Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart.
• Designed as the first in a series of “PERSONA INTERACTIVA” products.
• Mozart has 24 hours to unravel one of the greatest mysteries ever.

戴上手套，拿起工具，開始挖掘！地球正等待揭開它的秘密。

column2: 全国中学受験 偏差値55テストー義務教育をやり直し常識教養小学校教科書クイズー
column8:
全国の中学受験で実際に出題されるレベル、偏差値55相当の問題に挑戦する絵解きクイズです。
国語・算数・理科・社会・英語の主要5教科を、1問1答のテンポで気軽に総ざらいできます。

遊び方はかんたん
・問題文をよく読む
・画面に表示されたイラストの中から、正解だと思う場所にカーソルを合わせる（問題によっては文字の選択肢を選ぶことも）
・決まったら「A」ボタンで決定

間違えても大丈夫。
1問ごとに、なぜその答えになるのかをしっかり解説してくれるので、解いて終わりじゃなく「へえ、そうだったんだ」まで持っていけます。

偏差値55は、ちょうど中学受験の標準〜やや応用レベル。
漢字やことわざ、四字熟語から、立体図形、理科の実験、社会のしくみ、英文法まで——大人でも「あれ、意外と出てこない」となる問題ばかりです。

中学受験を控えたお子さんの力試しはもちろん、
親子で一緒にワイワイ挑戦するのにもピッタリ！
1問1答でサクサク進むので、スキマ時間の学習にもおすすめです。

こんな人におすすめ！
・中学受験対策になる学習ソフトを探している
・国語・算数・理科・社会・英語の5教科をまとめて復習したい
・間違えた問題もその場で解説を読んで理解を定着させたい
・文章を読むのがまだ得意でない子どもと一緒に取り組みたい
・親子で気軽に力試しがしたい
